_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paypal_me" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "iban_hint" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "fx_rate_ppm" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fx_rate_ppm" > 0), "group_amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("group_amount_cents" > 0), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('regular', 'trip', 'settlement')), "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("split_mode" IN ('equal', 'shares', 'percent', 'exact')), "trip_meta" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_payers" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses (id), "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "paid_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("paid_cents" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("expense_id", "member_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_shares" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses (id), "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "share_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("share_cents" > -1), "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weight" > -1), PRIMARY KEY ("expense_id", "member_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "from_member" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "to_member" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("method" IN ('paypal', 'sepa', 'cash', 'other')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_member_bank" ("member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "iban" TEXT NOT NULL, "bic" TEXT NULL, "account_name" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("member_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "fuel_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("fuel_type" IN ('petrol', 'diesel', 'electric', 'other')), "consumption_milli_per100km" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("consumption_milli_per100km" > 0), "wear_milli_per_km" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("wear_milli_per_km" >= 0), "km_rate_milli_per_km" INTEGER NULL CHECK("km_rate_milli_per_km" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ride_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_meters" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("distance_meters" >= 0), "round_trip" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("round_trip" IN (0, 1)), "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "default_driver_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "default_passenger_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "tolls_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("tolls_cents" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_meters" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("distance_meters" >= 0), "round_trip" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("round_trip" IN (0, 1)), "tolls_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("tolls_cents" >= 0), "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "driver_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "passenger_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "driver_counts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("driver_counts" IN (0, 1)), "price_per_unit_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_unit_milli" >= 0), "use_km_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("use_km_rate" IN (0, 1)), "settled_expense_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expenses (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses (id), "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("revision" > 0), "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_member_id" TEXT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX members_group_id ON members (group_id)
CREATE INDEX expenses_group_id ON expenses (group_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_payers_expense_id ON expense_payers (expense_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_payers_group_id ON expense_payers (group_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_payers_member_id ON expense_payers (member_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_shares_expense_id ON expense_shares (expense_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_shares_group_id ON expense_shares (group_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_shares_member_id ON expense_shares (member_id)
CREATE INDEX settlements_group_id ON settlements (group_id)
CREATE INDEX vehicles_group_id ON vehicles (group_id)
CREATE INDEX ride_templates_group_id ON ride_templates (group_id)
CREATE INDEX rides_group_date ON rides (group_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expense_revisions_expense_revision ON expense_revisions (expense_id, revision)
CREATE INDEX expense_revisions_group_id ON expense_revisions (group_id)
